Our Story

The Early Days

Back in the lockdown days of 2020, I finally had time and space to have a go at making my first pizza oven. Mixing up clay and sand and building the dome was fun and lots of hard work! I didn't keep it for too long, as it was the wrong height and too small — but it made some really good pizzas.

The plans expanded within the second lockdown season to build a brick pizza oven on a wooden base. It took a couple of months of my spare time, but I loved using it once it was done. It was a real pleasure to cook outdoors with the warmth of a wood fire coming at me. The pizza-making got better, and I even did some bread-baking in there. In fact, the pizza-making had been preceded by a few years of sourdough and baguette baking, which stood me in good stead for the dough journey ahead.

Within 18 months we found ourselves moving house and, naturally, leaving the brick oven behind. Some sympathetic and generous friends, however, clubbed together to get me my first Ooni for my 50th birthday, and the journey resumed. One day at church, a friend asked if I could do pizza for his child's dedication party — which I did, and that's where the mobile pizza catering began!

Taking voluntary redundancy from my long-standing teaching job allowed me to invest in a pizza trailer, put together by Westwood Conversions in Sheffield. It's been a pleasure to use, and the eye-catching colour scheme is down to my wife's good taste.

The opportunity to do regular sessions at The Gardeners Arms in Morley came up in the autumn of 2025, and together with a mix of weddings, corporate and private parties, I've had the pleasure of serving up thousands of pizzas.

Weddings

Pizza at your Wedding Reception

Our pizza buffet for weddings is always a hit. Choose Pizza le Bob for your big day and you get to pick five pizza types from a broad menu — everything from popular classics to newer, less common flavour combinations.

View the current menu selection

We keep a shared document between us to record all the essentials, including dietary requirements and allergies. Good communication all the way through makes for a happy day.

On the day itself, a nicely presented table is set up with labelled wooden boards, and guests help themselves — no long queues, just fresh Neapolitan pizza adding to the special feel of your day. Our friendly helpers keep the table well-stocked and looking its best throughout, and we're happy to be flexible to meet most requests and variations.

Every pizza is made from scratch — from the long-proved dough to the San Marzano tomato sauce, authentic Italian fior di latte mozzarella, and other fresh ingredients.

Privacy notice

Robert Westerdale, trading as Pizza le Bob, is responsible for personal information collected through this website. Contact pizzalebob@gmail.com or 07989 836477 about your information.

We collect the contact and event details you supply to answer enquiries, provide quotes and arrange catering. For individuals booking for themselves, this is to take steps at your request before entering a contract, and to perform that contract. For business contacts, our legitimate interest is responding to business enquiries and managing catering bookings. We do not add enquiry contacts to marketing lists.

Please do not submit guests’ names, allergies, medical details or other sensitive information through these forms. Discuss essential catering requirements separately when arranging your booking.

Cloudflare hosts this website. The planned direct email service uses Resend to deliver enquiries to our Google Gmail inbox. These providers may process information outside the UK. Appropriate processor agreements and international-transfer safeguards must be in place before the new forms are enabled.

Enquiry information is needed to respond; without sufficient contact details we may not be able to help. We retain correspondence only for as long as needed to handle your enquiry, booking and any related legal or accounting obligations. Unneeded enquiry correspondence should be deleted. There is no automated decision-making or profiling.

You can ask for access to, correction of or deletion of your information, and may have rights to restriction, portability or to object, depending on the circumstances and lawful basis. Contact us using the details above. You can complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint.

Cookies and external services

The public page contains no advertising trackers or cookie-setting code of its own. Cloudflare may use necessary security cookies. Google Fonts requests disclose connection information to Google. The embedded map contacts Google only after you select Enable Google map; Google may then use cookies under its own privacy policy. Remove Google map stops the embed; it cannot delete cookies already set by Google. Get directions opens Google Maps separately.
